**Finding: Deviation — Section 22.14 (Solicitation), paragraph p0302.**

The clause is mutual, but it bars soliciting *any* employee of the other party, *for any reason*, for the full Term (a multi-year period, per the 18-month renewal-notice mechanic in Section 2.2), with no carve-outs. It therefore fails the playbook fallback on scope, duration and carve-outs.

Proposed redline (validated, fallback level): limit the restriction to personnel directly involved in the performance or receipt of the Services, cap it at 12 months after their involvement ends, and add the customary general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. No no-hire language is present, so nothing to delete on that front.
